new.title: Public transport and Arrangement Position inputs
new.contract: D-manual (A6.3; ARR-B028–035): Play and Stop request Arrangement playback start/stop; space toggles playback. The insert marker determines the ordinary start position; Shift-space continues from the last stopped position. Home (Win) / Function-left (Mac) returns the marker to the starting play position. Double Stop remains Session REQ003. Selecting an Arrangement Position bars/beats/sixteenths field permits vertical drag, typed number plus Enter or up/down arrows; adjusting the fields moves the insert marker. The publisher initial-marker wording is documentation context, not observed factory/reset behavior. Engine timing, parsing, sample/beat arithmetic, competing starts, range/rounding and universal key interception remain U.

new.title: Chase MIDI Notes option
new.contract: D-manual (A6.3; ARR-B040): Options Chase MIDI Notes can deactivate/reactivate the documented chase behavior when playback begins inside a note. The publisher describes chasing as default; initial, saved/custom and reset histories remain distinct and unverified. This names an option and intended context only. Note messages, scheduling, audible output, numeric timing, channel/voice and default initialization remain U under the existing Playback late-note obligation.

new.title: Unfold and resize Arrangement tracks
new.contract: D-manual (A6.9; ARR-B104): the button next to a track name or U unfolds selected tracks to access clip time. The split line changes unfolded height; Alt+/Alt− (Win) / Option+/Option− (Mac) are named alternatives. Alt (Win) / Option (Mac) pinch resizes on a supported trackpad/touchscreen. Holding that modifier while resizing one track resizes all; modifier-clicking the unfold button or AltU (Win) / OptionU (Mac) unfolds all. Capability, actual key dispatch, limits, geometry, persistence and unsupported input hardware remain U.

new.title: Arrangement mixer entrypoints and control surfaces
new.contract: D-manual (A6.1, A6.15; ARR-B013/B019/B160–164): the Arrangement mixer is offered by View Mixer, CtrlAltM (Win) / CmdOptionM (Mac), and the bottom-right mixer control. View Mixer Controls customizes mixer controls; View Arrangement Track Controls separately customizes individual track controls. The source states shared values/settings between those surfaces; Performance Impact, track delays and crossfader are named mixer-only examples. Mixing REQ001/MXW001 already owns actual access to the section/components and individual controls; Engine ER006/007 and Mixing MXW015 own their named displays. No all-control bijection, new mixer coefficient, track-delay/CPU law, key interception or layout persistence is inferred.
